qa_audit.doable_note: Step 10 (image_fill_area to "place the white-bg hero onto a solid pure-#FFFFFF square 1:1 canvas... extends the white field to a square") is not connector-doable: image_fill_area is a SOLID-color fill of a selection WITHIN the existing canvas — it cannot extend/grow the canvas or composite an image onto a larger square canvas. Squaring a non-square image requires canvas padding/extension, which only the banned image_generative_expand does. The reverify explicitly swapped the banned generative_expand for image_fill_area, but image_fill_area physically cannot produce a square 2048x2048 canvas from the non-square source. All other 15 steps are real, doable [C] Adobe actions.
